body:
The Beast x86 gate for PR 2b stopped in structure preflight at revision cab966e76c46d9a6eae343ba8bb5bf564d1ee24b.

`tests/gate_qmp_backstop_structure.rs::missing_socket_and_hung_dump_are_partial_and_bounded` failed at line 474 with `hang must reach dump`. The suite reported socat present, passed the qmp_timeout result and elapsed-time assertions, then failed to find `RECV dump-guest-memory ` in the fake server log. Result: 14/15 tests passed; gate preflight 65/66.

This followed a separate 300-second context_restore_structure timeout at host load 15.62. The x86 gate was relaunched once with BREENIX_STRUCTURE_SUITE_TIMEOUT_SECS=900; context_restore_structure then passed in 368 seconds, but the QMP fixture failed. No x86 kernel build or boot was reached. No additional gate retry was run.

PR 2b changes scheduler.rs and loopback_pump_structure.rs. The failing test and gate-qmp-backstop.sh are unchanged from starting revision 58af1a7f. Host timing is a possible explanation, not an attributed cause; preserve the requirement that the hang leg actually reaches the dump command.

Evidence on branch sched/3f-pr2b-pinned-wake-scan-bound:
- docs/planning/green-program/aarch64-testing/serials/3f-pr2b/13-x86-preflight-timeout.txt
- docs/planning/green-program/aarch64-testing/serials/3f-pr2b/16-x86-retry.txt
- docs/planning/green-program/aarch64-testing/serials/3f-pr2b/17-x86-qmp-failure.txt
- docs/planning/green-program/aarch64-testing/3F-PR2B-2026-09-07.md

Follow-up: reproduce the failed fake-QMP handshake/dump sequence under load, identify which phase exhausted the budget, and repair its producing defect without accepting an unexecuted dump leg. Then resume the required x86 validation for PR 2b.
title: QMP backstop hang fixture times out before reaching dump on Beast preflight
